library.reproduction: The existing minimal AC1021 MATERIAL channel-flags path published a requiresRawDxfMaterialReplay object to an interface without the raw capture policy because its marker was set after the policy check. A local non-opted probe returned success with a raw-only material callback before the fix and refusal with zero material callbacks after it.
library.fix: Check both pending sparse/minimal tails and already-marked records against the existing explicit raw capture policy before publishing. No new interface virtual is added.
validation: The ASCII and binary generated minimal profile refuses legacy and disabled-policy readers without material or raw callbacks; enabling the policy on the same reader then succeeds with the raw-only marker and channel flags preserved.
Focused release CTest: five material reader, transaction, ordering and raw-policy cases passed.
AddressSanitizer: instrumented raw-material test passed with leak detection disabled.
Clean-checkout digest verification reports 775 inputs; the frozen support-status join reports zero advertised routes and 15 experimental claims.

consumer.fix: Capture the raw-only material property into document metadata using an optional-method compatibility fallback. Before DXF or DWG output, reject while such a record exists; do not reconstruct the incomplete typed record. The codec interface is public so an explicitly opted-in derived filter is discoverable; the production filter itself does not opt in.
validation: The default filter rejects a locally generated AC1021 minimal MATERIAL. A derived filter explicitly opting in imports it through the real LibreCAD filter and preserves the raw-only marker. The ordinary exporter preserves the destination while refusing three DXF versions and DWG, then successfully saves a complete material on the same filter.

System-codec focused lane: 2,071 assertions in 32 cases passed after a full consumer test-target rebuild against the isolated current shared library. DYLD_PRINT_LIBRARIES confirmed the exact library path; installed public headers and implementation code are unchanged since the test-only digest refresh.
Bundled-codec DXF round-trip lane: 4,751 assertions in 143 cases passed after rebuilding the affected target.
The independent compact-material graph CTest passed, exercising the other sparse-tail policy branch.

An earlier derived-filter test passed incorrectly because the old library failed to enforce opt-in. When enforcement was fixed it failed correctly: private interface inheritance prevented the cross-cast. Public interface inheritance now permits the explicitly opted-in real filter, with no new virtual; the earlier result is superseded.

The existing AC1021 missing-carrier and corrected-retry control runs in the same focus.

limits: The production filter does not opt in and the consumer refuses all exports containing a marked raw-only material until complete graph validation and same-version replay are implemented.
The selected graph controls do not establish general graph behavior after edits or native material semantics.
Native GUI, external semantic evidence and final platform qualification remain open.
